name: deck
description: House-format HTML lecture decks (deck/shell.html + deck/sections/*.html + GSAP motions, 1920x1080, RALPHDEV brand). Rule originals (korean-style, deck-copy, deck-authoring) live in this plugin and are copied into each deck repo's .claude/rules/ with a version stamp. Tools run from the plugin, never copied: build, dev server with in-browser edit, copy check, Playwright render and interaction checks, Vercel deploy. Skills: deck-new (scaffold), deck-author (writing sections), deck-assets (logos, icon sheets, mascot cuts), deck-check (build + QA + rule drift), deck-sync (refresh rule copies and vendor), deck-deploy (explicit request only). Generic one-off presentations belong to frontend-slides.
